subject: C-suite Slate: Compensation Corridor Assignments & Approval Runbook
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: recruiting@hirewave.com, ellie.harper@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-06-20T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: C-suite Slate: Compensation Corridor Assignments & Approval Runbook

Team —

Attached is my first pass at the Q3 C-suite slate: I mapped proposed compensation corridors (base + target OTE corridors), recommended grade placements, and the initial offer levers we planned to hold for Exec Committee approval. Key asks:

- Please review the "Proposed Band" column and note any redlines by EOD Tuesday (6/22).
- Confirm whether any of the four roles (CPO, CRO, Head of Infra, Head of Ops) need an exception to the standard corridor.
- Legal and Recruiting are looped for intake timing and suggested offer language.

I've kept conservative pacing on headcount release — we have 2 net new exec slots in Q3 (noted on tab 'HC_Alloc'). If we agree on corridors, I'll assemble the short approval runbook and circulate for Exec Committee sign-off.

Attachments: Q3_C-Suite_Band_Proposals.xlsx (spreadsheet with per-role bands and comp math)

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, recruiting@hirewave.com, legal@external-legal.com
Date: 2026-06-21T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: C-suite Slate: Compensation Corridor Assignments & Approval Runbook

Marcus —

Thanks for the doc. Quick notes after a first pass:

- On the Head of Infra role, I think the midpoint is ~8% above market for the top quartile; recommend tightening the corridor downward by $20k to avoid anchoring above budget.
- For CRO, prefer keeping target OTE at 120% not 125% to preserve comp ratio across GTM.
- Please add a one-line justification for each exception in a new column — makes Exec Committee decisions faster.

Process ask: before we go to Exec Committee, can we include a two-slide summary (1: ask + band summary, 2: fiscal impact and runway) to be distributed 24 hours before the meeting? That will help the reviewers.

Attachment: C-Suite_Req_Summary.pdf (one-pager with role blurbs I drafted)

Laura Bennett
Chief People Officer
Redwood Inference

All —

Thanks for the quick review. I agree with Laura on tightening the Infra corridor and with the CRO OTE adjustment. Two operational notes:

1) Exec Committee prefers a consolidated fiscal impact line (total incremental run-rate + hiring timing). Marcus — can you capture that in the runbook?
2) I'll need the final ask packaged by Tuesday morning 6/24 so we can slot it for the Wednesday Exec Committee briefing. If legal needs more time for any specific terms, flag ASAP; we may need to stagger approvals.

One-line reply from me: good to proceed once the two edits are applied and the two-slide summary is attached.

Aditya

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: C-suite Slate: Compensation Corridor Assignments & Approval Runbook

Thanks all — finalizing the runbook now. Summary of decisions and next steps below (this will be the body of the two-slide packet):

Decisions implemented:
- Head of Infra corridor tightened by $20,000 (midpoint adjusted).
- CRO target OTE set to 120% (reverted from 125%).
- Added a one-line justification column for exceptions in the spreadsheet.

Operational runbook (short):
1) Marcus to upload Approval_Runbook_v1.docx to the Drive folder (done). Link above.
2) Laura to circulate the two-slide packet to Exec Committee by 6/25 09:00 PT.
3) Aditya will run the Exec Committee review 6/25 afternoon; we expect a 48-hour decision window.
4) Recruiting will prepare offer templates with the approved band copy; Legal to sign off on final terms before offers go out.
5) No offers to be extended until Exec Committee sign-off (per Aditya).

Attachments: Approval_Runbook_v1.docx (contains timeline, approver list, escalation path), Q3_C-Suite_Band_Proposals.xlsx (updated with changes)

If there are no further objections, I will queue the packet and confirm the Exec Committee slot.

Marcus Lin
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
